description.en: Clears every position-role lock previously set with CMND_BTL_SET_POS_LOCK, for every match member at once.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if the call was invalid.

example.code:
// Clear every position lock once the scripted sequence is done
CMND_BTL_RESET_POS_LOCK();
